text:
maria: Quick kickoff — we want a short launch post + 45-min hands-on webinar for the 'Lil Bridge' reference app this Thurs. Goals: 1) drive 500 dev signups, 2) collect benchmark feedback, 3) seed 50 GH stars. :rocket:

devin: love it. proposed cadence: blog post live Tue AM, webinar Wed EOD? email drip Wed morning.

samir: important to include benchmark narrative — show latency/cost before+after using Redwood Optimize. we have numbers from eng: 2.4x token throughput, 30% cost reduction on our sample prompt set.

elaine: I can produce small benchmark chart + demo script. need the final prompt set by EOD Mon. Also I'll add a "repro steps" gist.

maria: great. Devin, can you draft the post outline? include TL;DR, 3 screenshots (console, perf chart, refapp UI), and a 1-min gif.

devin: on it. draft link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abcDEFghiJKL (placeholder). Will add CTA to join the webinar + repo link.

maria: inbound lead routing: @samir can you confirm HubSpot form mapping? we want tag=refapp_lilbridge and campaign=refapp_q1. Also create a high-priority lead flow to AE queue for >10 seats signups.

samir: confirmed. I'll add a Zap from form -> hubspot -> notify #sales. Tag names: [refapp_lilbridge, mini_launch_q1]

elaine: quick note: demo requires a small local docker compose to run model + infra. I'll attach a tiny docker-compose snippet in the demo repo.

maria: content checklist:
- blog draft
- webinar slide deck
- demo repo + quickstart
- benchmark report + images
- social copy + 2 emails

devin: tweeting plan: 3 tweets thread + short video clip. draft sample:
```
Tweet 1: We built Lil Bridge — a tiny refapp showing low-latency LLM inference w/ Redwood Inference. Try the demo → <repo link>
Tweet 2: Benchmarks: 2.4x throughput, 30% cost drop vs baseline. How? Batching + prefix cache + quantized model.
Tweet 3: Join our webinar Wed to see the code + deploy tips. Register: <webinar link>
```

samir: also make a benchmarking narrative blurb for the blog: 'From dev to production: reducing token cost without sacrificing latency' + callout box on methodology.

maria: timeline: Mon EOD: draft ready. Tue AM: publish blog. Tue PM: social push. Wed: webinar rehearsal. Thu: webinar live.

devin: can someone record a 3-minute walkthrough clip for the tweet? Elaine?

elaine: yes — I can record Tuesday lunchtime. Will upload to the draft doc.

deploy-bot: Reminder: webinar landing page scheduled deploy at 2025-04-09T15:00Z :white_check_mark:

maria: awesome. let's sync Mon 10:30 for final readthrough. :eyes:

devin: added to calendar. thanks team!
